title: Killa Mango Ice Nic Pouches - 13.2mg / pouch
description: Killa Mango Ice Nicotine Pouches offer a tropical twist with the sweet, juicy flavour of ripe mangoes, enhanced by a refreshing icy finish. Each pouch contains 13.2mg of nicotine, making it suitable for adult users who prefer a satisfying yet measured nicotine release. The Mango Ice flavour provides a vibrant combination of tropical sweetness and coolness, delivering a smooth, long-lasting and enjoyable taste. These pouches are entirely tobacco-free, providing a clean and convenient alternative to traditional nicotine products. The discreet design of Killa Mango Ice pouches makes them ideal for use in various settings, whether you're on the move, at work, or in a social environment where traditional nicotine use isn’t feasible. Killa Nicotine Pouches are crafted with a focus on consistency and quality, ensuring a reliable nicotine experience. Simply place a pouch between your upper lip and gum, and enjoy a steady release of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With 20 pouches per pack, Killa Mango Ice offers a practical and refreshing option for those who enjoy a cool, fruity twist while relieving nicotine cravings. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a steady nicotine release for up to 30min. 2 Place the used nicotine pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
